AgentId.description: Registered agent identifier: "agent:" followed by a lowercase slug.

CapabilityId.title: CapabilityId
CapabilityId.description: Opaque, stable capability identity: dot-namespaced qualified name; the extension scoping unit (lock rule 9).

SemverCore.title: SemverCore
SemverCore.description: Semantic-version core (major.minor.patch, digits only, no prerelease/build suffixes).
